GENERAL SCIENCE — MOCK EXAM #16
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: GENERAL SCIENCE
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying The Ecosystems? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about The Ecosystems.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for The Ecosystems.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on The Ecosystems.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to The Ecosystems.

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Electrostatics? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Electrostatics.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Electrostatics.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Electrostatics.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Electrostatics.

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Polymers? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Polymers.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Polymers.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Polymers.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Polymers.

4. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. watt (W)
   B. newton (N)
   C. joule (J)
   D. pascal (Pa)

5. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Overgrazing continuously
   B. Burning crop residue every week
   C. Removing all vegetation
   D. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

6. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture of two liquids
   B. Any substance that conducts electricity
   C. Any white crystal used in cooking
   D. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

7. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only carbon dioxide
   B. Only water vapour
   C. Nitrogen gas only
   D. Glucose and oxygen

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Alkanols, Alkanoic Acids and Esters.? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Alkanols, Alkanoic Acids and Esters..
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Alkanols, Alkanoic Acids and Esters..
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Alkanols, Alkanoic Acids and Esters..
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Alkanols, Alkanoic Acids and Esters..

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Detergents ● Soapy and soapless detergents ● Preparations of detergents ● Mode o? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Detergents ● Soapy and soapless detergents ● Preparations of detergents ● Mode o.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Detergents ● Soapy and soapless detergents ● Preparations of detergents ● Mode o.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Detergents ● Soapy and soapless detergents ● Preparations of detergents ● Mode o.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Detergents ● Soapy and soapless detergents ● Preparations of detergents ● Mode o.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Evolution and Biodiversity? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Evolution and Biodiversity.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Evolution and Biodiversity.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Evolution and Biodiversity.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Evolution and Biodiversity.

11. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Iron rusting
   B. Milk souring
   C. Ice melting to water
   D. Paper burning to ash

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Skeletal and Muscular System? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Skeletal and Muscular System.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Skeletal and Muscular System.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Skeletal and Muscular System.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Skeletal and Muscular System.

13. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Petrol fires have no fuel
   B. Water removes heat too quickly
   C. Water always increases oxygen
   D. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

14. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   B. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   C. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   D. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio

15. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Decomposers only
   B. Primary consumers only
   C. Producers
   D. Tertiary consumers

16. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Electrostatics 3.2 Current Electricity 3.3 Mains Electricity 3.4 Projectile Moti? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Electrostatics 3.2 Current Electricity 3.3 Mains Electricity 3.4 Projectile Moti.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Electrostatics 3.2 Current Electricity 3.3 Mains Electricity 3.4 Projectile Moti.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Electrostatics 3.2 Current Electricity 3.3 Mains Electricity 3.4 Projectile Moti.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Electrostatics 3.2 Current Electricity 3.3 Mains Electricity 3.4 Projectile Moti.

17. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 100 °C
   B. 0 °C
   C. 50 °C
   D. 37 °C

18. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cell division? (1 mark)

   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Electrolysis.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Electrolysis.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Electrolysis.

20. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Movement of water only across a membrane
   B. A chemical reaction forming ash
   C. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   D. Heating until a solid melts

21. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Carbon and its Oxides? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Carbon and its Oxides.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Carbon and its Oxides.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Carbon and its Oxides.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Carbon and its Oxides.

   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Introduction to Genetics ● Meaning of terms and concepts in genetics (Deoxyribon.
